epistemic_status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED: Code exists and executes without runtime errors.
epistemic_status_definitions.UNIT_TESTED: Automated unit tests verify local input/output specifications and edge cases.
epistemic_status_definitions.EMPIRICALLY_VALIDATED: Controlled empirical experiments demonstrate the claimed phenomenon under tested model configurations and seeds.
epistemic_status_definitions.ROBUSTLY_VALIDATED: Validated across multiple seeds, model scales, context lengths, and distribution-shift benchmarks with confidence intervals.
epistemic_status_definitions.FORMALLY_VERIFIED: Mathematical proof whose explicit assumptions match the machine-checked execution bounds.
epistemic_status_definitions.OPEN_RESEARCH: Active research hypothesis, open problem, or incomplete phase.
